title: Medtrum S7 supported?
body: Medtrum A6 is supported by xdrip, it is the new medtrum s7 supported as well?

comments.body: Out of the box probably not, if it uses the same protocol then there is a good chance with some small modifications.
Based on discussions with Medtrum I believe the protocol is going to be identical, so I would expect it to work. However there is no substitute for testing!
Can someone confirm that xdrip working with s7?
I have the new A6 Slim and this is not working with Xdrip i dont know about the S7 but maybe it runs on the same code as this new transmitter i got.
Would you please update the current status?
